text:
Next for Sora: his GET-UP after the knockdown. He starts lying flat on his back, face up, head toward screen left and feet toward screen right, Keyblade on the floor beside his right hip (attached image 1), and ends in his battle idle facing screen right (attached image 2). Attached image 3 is the approved hurt set for style and context.




My director's rules: the knees must always bend the natural way, and he holds the Keyblade in his right hand the whole time (both hands back on it in the final idle).




Please generate an image: a clean concept sheet of Sora's get-up, facing screen right, plain white background, the same 2D cel style, KH2 outfit and Kingdom Key as the attached sprites, the same character size in every pose, no text or labels. 6 poses in order:

1. Lying flat on his back (as in image 1), starting to move.

2. Sitting up: torso rising off the floor, knees bending up, left hand pushing on the floor behind him.

3. Rolling forward onto one knee: weight coming over his feet, Keyblade lifted off the floor.

4. Kneeling on one knee, the other foot planted, Keyblade held ready in his right hand.

5. Rising to his feet, knees still bent, the left hand coming to the Keyblade's handle.

6. Back in the battle idle (as in image 2), both hands on the Keyblade.
